summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC (the Fund) filed an 8-K to report the pricing on May 5, 2026 and issuance on May 7, 2026 of $300 million aggregate principal amount of 6.550% Notes due 2032 in a Rule 144A/Regulation S offering. The notes were issued at 100.604% of face value plus accrued interest, yielding 6.421% to maturity. They constitute additional notes under an existing indenture, rank as general unsecured senior obligations, and are fungible with $500 million of existing notes issued January 2025. The notes mature March 15, 2032, pay semi-annual interest, and are redeemable at the Fund's option. The Fund must maintain asset coverage per the Investment Company Act. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
